content.comment_body: Hi, I'd appreciate advice on how to scale a temperature signal from a PT100 sensor connected to an RTD module so it outputs 1V to 10V on the analog module. Please refer to the attached image. Is this configuration possible? Thanks.
Just to clarify, the control output will be connected to a control input of an inverter. Analog threshold is not needed or suitable for this specific project application.
Why isn't the threshold necessary? You want to map a temperature range of 55 to 65 °C to an output of 1–10V on the analog module, correct? In that case, you should use the circuit as I suggested.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is looking for assistance in mapping the output of a PT100 sensor, via an RTD module, to a 1–10V analog range suitable for an inverter connection. Discussions highlight questions regarding analog thresholds and suggest that clearer instructions and documentation are needed for scenarios involving analog signal scaling.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants a straightforward way to scale temperature signals to a 1–10V analog output, with easy setup and clear examples tailored to this type of application, preferably without requiring analog threshold configuration.
